summary: InMode Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, announcing its annual general meeting of shareholders to be held on July 30, 2026. The meeting will consider the re-election of Dr. Hadar Ron as a Class I director, re-appointment of Kesselman & Kesselman (PwC Israel) as independent auditors for FY2026, and approval of 6,000 RSUs to non-executive directors. The board recommends a FOR vote on all proposals. This is a routine shareholder meeting notification, not a special situation. The proxy statement and record date of June 26, 2026, are included. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions are present.
